description: Changes an agent's status (`active` or `paused`), its daily and hourly send limits, its recipient allowlist and blocklist, whether its new mail is read for intent, or forwarding mode for an agent at an address on the workspace's own domain (turning it on or off starts its forwarding test again). An archived agent's status cannot change. A key tied to the agent, or an app connected by signing in, cannot change its limits or domain lists. Returns the agent.

address.description: The agent's own address, which never changes: any other address answers 400. Accepted so a body that names it alongside `forwarding` works.

allowlist_domains.description: When set, this agent sends only to these domains and their subdomains (`acme.com` covers `mail.acme.com`). A recipient in `to`, `cc` or `bcc` outside the list refuses the whole send with 422 `recipient_not_allowed`, in test mode too. A leading `@` is ignored. The test address reply@test.mails.ai is always allowed.

blocklist_domains.description: This agent never sends to these domains or their subdomains. A recipient in `to`, `cc` or `bcc` on the list refuses the whole send with 422 `recipient_not_allowed`, in test mode too. The test address reply@test.mails.ai is never blocked.

classify_inbound.description: Turns intent classification of new mail on or off (never replies in a thread). Turning it on needs a paid plan (402 `feature_not_enabled`); left out, it stays as it is.

daily_send_limit.description: This agent's own cap on recipients in any 24 hours, on top of your plan's cap: each live send counts once per `to`, `cc` and `bcc` address. Past it a send is refused with 429 `daily_limit_exceeded`, whose `resets_at` says when the send fits again (with a `Retry-After` header only when that is a minute or less away). Test-mode sends are neither counted nor refused. `null` removes it, leaving only your plan's cap.

forwarding.description: Forwarding mode, for an address on your own domain: the mail service hosting it forwards its mail to the agent's `forwarding_address`, so no MX record changes. `POST /v1/agents/{id}/forwarding/verify` then sends a test through the forward. Turning it on or off starts `forwarding_status` again from `not_verified`.

hourly_send_limit.description: This agent's own cap on recipients in any hour, on top of your plan's cap: each live send counts once per `to`, `cc` and `bcc` address. Past it a send is refused with 429 `hourly_limit_exceeded`, whose `resets_at` says when the send fits again (with a `Retry-After` header only when that is a minute or less away). Test-mode sends are neither counted nor refused. `null` removes it, leaving only your plan's cap.

status.description: `paused` makes the agent's send requests fail with 422 `agent_paused`; `active` resumes it. A pause set by the bounce, complaint or abuse checks cannot be lifted this way (403 `agent_suspended`).
